sideB.text:
UTOPIA

UTOPIA
CANNOT
BE IMPROVED.

Red city art. A black label over the upgrade panel reads UTOPIA CANNOT BE IMPROVED, with CANNOT in red. A green ring sits below the label.

rules: Red Infection card for Utopia. Eight copies, all this face.
Utopia cannot be improved. No infection-card upgrade sticker can be placed on it. The usual white upgrade panel is covered by that notice.
When the package is opened, all 8 copies go to the Infection discard pile.
notes: The printed code is P8-11b, not P8-04b.
The green ring is the standard infection-card art, not a separate rule.
